what_this_records: This archive is TWO COMMITS, and this note says why. The run package and the receipt were committed first; this note completes the archive and is the commit the archive binds to. Two defects in the Coordinator's own archival work were caught by tools/research_dispatch.py's verifier rather than by the Coordinator, and both are recorded here rather than smoothed away.

defect_1_undeclared_artifacts.what: The source task TASK-20260915-4f4027 declared twelve artifact_paths on 2026-09-15, before anyone knew the run would be completed in two epochs. The resumption block then instructed epoch 2 to write its remaining work as NEW FILES rather than appending to the committed ones -- correct, since appending would have altered immutable artifacts and invalidated the A6 evidence banked against their bytes. That instruction necessarily created seven files the card did not name, and the Coordinator did not extend the list at the same time.
defect_1_undeclared_artifacts.how_it_surfaced: A completed archive must bind EXACTLY its declared set, so an undeclared artifact is an unbindable one and the verifier refused the archive. The first attempt at a fix was itself wrong: it bound nineteen paths chosen by the Coordinator's judgement of what mattered, which is not the rule.
defect_1_undeclared_artifacts.resolution: An additive amendment to the card's artifact_paths, recorded in artifact_paths_amendment, appending the seven epoch-2 files. Nothing removed, no original path changed. The bound set is now exactly the twenty declared artifacts of the archive and its source.

defect_2_commit_message_id_set.what: The verifier requires an archive's commit message to name every record id the archive declares. The first commit's message named EXP-ICPERF-e21835 and RUN-ICPERF-a4a24b but not BATCH-a33cda.
defect_2_commit_message_id_set.why_it_was_not_fixed_by_amending: The commit was already made. Amending or force-pushing a commit that carries archived run artifacts is forbidden -- a run receipt whose commit no longer exists is not reproducible -- so the archive is completed by a SECOND commit whose message carries the full id set, and commit_sha binds to that.
defect_2_commit_message_id_set.why_record_ids_were_not_trimmed_instead: Dropping BATCH-a33cda from record_ids would have made the check pass in one edit. That is the same move as adjusting a reference value to match a measurement, and it is refused here for the same reason: the declaration was made when the batch was designed and is not the Coordinator's to narrow after the fact to suit its own commit message.

binding.why_this_works: content_at_commit verifies the declared hashes against the archive's OWN commit rather than against HEAD (CORR-20260915-654160). All twenty declared paths exist with identical content at both commits, so binding the later one loses nothing and the earlier one stays reachable in history. Seven of the twenty were committed by the epoch 1 archive ecdd3bffd and are unchanged by either commit here; re-hashing them re-establishes that the bytes A6's evidence rests on are still the bytes epoch 1 measured.

epoch_1_paths_and_their_original_archive.note: Recorded for a reader tracing provenance. manifest.yaml and manifest-epoch2.yaml are a PAIR -- the second supersedes the first by reference -- and both are bound by this archive so no later reader can be shown one without the other.

asserts_nothing_scientific: A binding and declaration correction. No measurement, verdict, criterion or status is touched, and the acceptance verdict remains un-composed pending both validator reports.
